title: Review result
description: What the factory:review-pr skill emits in JSON mode, and what the eval runner reads.

repo.description: owner/name, or 'local/<directory name>' ('local/unknown' if even that fails) when there is no GitHub remote.

ticket.description: Jira key found in the PR title or branch name.

base.description: Commit SHA or ref the diff starts from.

head.description: Commit SHA or ref the diff ends at.

claude_md.description: A CLAUDE.md was found and read.

review_md.description: A REVIEW.md was found and read.

rules.description: .claude/rules files that applied to the changed paths.

summary.description: Two or three sentences: what the change does and the verdict.

posted.description: True when the findings were posted to the pull request as a COMMENT review.
